import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/data/body-size-evolution-in-south-american-freshwater-fishes.csv')
df.head()

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np

# List of evolutionary traits
evolutionary_traits = ['BEL_evol', 'MBL_evol', 'OGP_evol', 'RES_evol', 'RML_evol']

# Dictionary to store coefficients
coefficients = {}

# Perform linear regression for each trait
for trait in evolutionary_traits:
    X = df[[trait]].values.reshape(-1, 1)
    y = df['BAMM_speciation'].values
    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(X, y)
    coefficients[trait] = model.coef_[0]

coefficients
